chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: London, 2022. Real Madrid are at Chelsea. Karim Benzema drops deep to help. A one-two with Vinícius... and another! Now he sprints into the box. The cross... header! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Benzema comes back to link play. He passes to Vinícius and gets it back. Then again! Then he races forward!

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: Vinícius crosses, and Benzema heads it into the top corner. What a finish!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: a striker can drop deep to help build attacks, then sprint into the box to finish.
